scope: No residual or equilibrium evaluations. Fixed float64 saved state, material samples, source geometry and discrete quadrature. Extended arithmetic begins after these inputs; no remeshing, source interpolation recovery, tolerance change or geometry snapping. Native float64 geometry is matched bit-for-bit before comparisons. New arrays retain longdouble dtype in NPZ; JSON metrics are float64 summaries.
limitations: Independent log diagnostic restricted to relative rotations below 0.1 rad and not a proposed general replacement.
Effect on aerodynamic residual must be measured separately using the original kernel/core/exclusion rules.
Local coordinates reduce cancellation conditionally; no universal improvement is asserted for every source/receiver pair.
